commits.author: Dmitry Kropachev
commits.subject: feature: Adding toolset for implementing Deterministic and Conditional Random (DCR) tests       This toolset allows to build tests with following features:         1. Controllable Randomness. I.e. each run the test could/should be different.             The randomness should be controllable, so that it will allow to cover wide veriety of tests, and in the same time avoid running not wanted cases.         2. Repeatability. Random test that fails, should be repitable in easy manner.

pr.title: Deterministic and Conditional Random tests for paxos

commits.author: Alex
commits.subject: lwt_random_test: skip test_topology_grow in debug mode test_topology_grow starts a 3-node cluster and grows it to 5 nodes in debug mode, running one LWT loader per node the whole time and then validating every written key with a 600s request timeout. On a single dtest-debug agent this is five debug-mode scylla processes plus five concurrent Paxos loaders, which turns a correctness test into a stress test of the CI host. The test was already removed from next_gating for running over 40 minutes in debug. In dtest-debug build #688 it failed with 61% of keys unreadable during validation: node3's gossip scheduling group on shard 0 accumulated over 1000 queued Raft RPC sends to slow followers, and the reactor stayed pinned in that group for 18 minutes, starving CQL on that shard. That failure mode is not specific to debug builds and is tracked separately; running the test in debug only makes it likely to trigger, without adding coverage. The scenario is still exercised by the other dtest jobs, including the tablets and raft-topology-changes variants. test_topology_replace in the same class was excluded from debug for the same reason.

pr.title: lwt_random_test: skip test_topology_grow in debug mode
